summary: Cosan S.A., a Brazilian company, filed a 6-K reporting its Board of Directors' resolution to voluntarily delist its NYSE-listed ADSs (each representing four common shares) as part of a capital-structure simplification. The company notified the NYSE and plans to file Form 25 with the SEC on September 8, 2026, with a last trading day of September 18, 2026. Cosan will retain its B3 Novo Mercado listing and remain an SEC registrant, continuing Exchange Act reporting. No alternative exchange listing or quotation arrangement was made. The move targets cost reduction and strategic focus. The company reserves the right to delay or withdraw filings, so monitor for potential changes to the planned delisting timeline.
